exclusions.unreviewed_scaling: Only exact SCALE=0 definitions. Monetary amount scales and person counts with SCALE=3 remain unqualified.
exclusions.non_public_observations: Discovery archives with mixed access labels are not published. Only exact PUBLIC_OPEN/PUB series and responses pass the new adapter.

semantics.periods: Monthly, quarterly and annual source periods use explicit chart anchors. No daily interpolation or release-time inference.
semantics.numbers: Exact source decimal strings and all original attributes retained; finite binary64 chart rounding disclosed per observation.
semantics.transformations: Use published year-over-year or period-on-period series, not a fabricated growth calculation.
semantics.units: Exact percentage units and index reference bases; no monetary scaling assumption. Missing and excluded statuses remain null.
semantics.old_histories: Source last observation remains visible; a monthly policy rate is not the current policy decision.
